multi_constraint_queries.query: Find restaurants suitable for a business lunch where I can discuss confidential information, accommodate my client's vegetarian diet, and stay within a $40 per person budget
multi_constraint_queries.traditional_fails_because: Matches individual keywords but can't verify ALL constraints are met simultaneously
multi_constraint_queries.reasoning_succeeds_because: Can verify each constraint: confidential (private booths), vegetarian (extensive menu), budget ($35 including appetizer)

multi_constraint_queries.query: Find laptop-friendly cafes with strong WiFi, power outlets, and quiet work environment policies
multi_constraint_queries.traditional_fails_because: Matches 'laptop' and 'WiFi' but misses policy details about noise management
multi_constraint_queries.reasoning_succeeds_because: Understands the complete work environment requirements including noise policy

multi_constraint_queries.query: Find restaurants that can safely accommodate severe food allergies with proper protocols
multi_constraint_queries.traditional_fails_because: Matches 'allergies' but doesn't understand severity or safety protocols needed
multi_constraint_queries.reasoning_succeeds_because: Recognizes comprehensive allergy management: separate prep areas, trained staff, manager involvement

contextual_inference_queries.query: Find family-friendly restaurants that can handle energetic children without disturbing other diners
contextual_inference_queries.traditional_fails_because: Matches 'family-friendly' and 'children' but misses nuanced noise management context
contextual_inference_queries.reasoning_succeeds_because: Infers noise management from 'high ceilings that absorb sound' and separate family section

contextual_inference_queries.query: Find restaurants that cater specifically to senior citizens with appropriate accommodations
contextual_inference_queries.traditional_fails_because: Might match 'senior' but doesn't understand accommodation context
contextual_inference_queries.reasoning_succeeds_because: Recognizes senior-specific accommodations: early bird specials, larger print menus, comfortable seating

contextual_inference_queries.query: Find restaurants with extremely loud environments that prevent conversation
contextual_inference_queries.reasoning_succeeds_because: Understands the acoustic environment: 'echo chamber effect', 'shouting across table'

conditional_logic_queries.query: Find restaurants that are good for first dates but only if the person is not vegetarian
conditional_logic_queries.traditional_fails_because: Can't process conditional logic 'good for X BUT only if Y'
conditional_logic_queries.reasoning_succeeds_because: Understands conditional: perfect for meat-eaters, disappointing for vegetarians

conditional_logic_queries.query: Find restaurants that are only good when weather conditions are perfect
conditional_logic_queries.reasoning_succeeds_because: Recognizes conditional quality: amazing when weather permits, mediocre indoors

conditional_logic_queries.query: Find restaurants specifically for carnivores that have no vegetarian options
conditional_logic_queries.traditional_fails_because: Matches 'meat' but doesn't understand the exclusivity aspect
conditional_logic_queries.reasoning_succeeds_because: Understands meat-focused exclusivity: 'absolutely nothing for vegetarians'

temporal_reasoning_queries.query: Find restaurants that were good in the past but have declined recently
temporal_reasoning_queries.traditional_fails_because: Can't understand temporal relationships or change over time
temporal_reasoning_queries.reasoning_succeeds_because: Tracks temporal decline: 'used to be our go-to', 'something changed after new management'

temporal_reasoning_queries.query: Find restaurants that have improved significantly over time

negation_exclusion_queries.query: Find restaurants that explicitly mention they are NOT suitable for large groups
negation_exclusion_queries.traditional_fails_because: Traditional systems are notoriously bad at negation
negation_exclusion_queries.reasoning_succeeds_because: Processes negation clearly: 'NOT a place for groups larger than 4'

negation_exclusion_queries.query: Find restaurants that do NOT accept reservations under any circumstances
negation_exclusion_queries.reasoning_succeeds_because: Understands absolute policy: 'absolutely DO NOT take reservations'

negation_exclusion_queries.query: Find restaurants that exclude minors after certain hours
negation_exclusion_queries.reasoning_succeeds_because: Recognizes exclusion policy: '21+ policy after 8 PM - NO exceptions'

comparative_reasoning_queries.query: Find restaurants that are better than their more famous competitors but still affordable
comparative_reasoning_queries.traditional_fails_because: Can't handle relative comparisons or understand competitive relationships
comparative_reasoning_queries.reasoning_succeeds_because: Processes comparisons: 'better and half the price', 'better steaks at 60% of the price'

meta_reasoning_queries.query: Find restaurants where the reviewer initially had low expectations but was pleasantly surprised
meta_reasoning_queries.traditional_fails_because: Can't track reviewer's emotional journey or changing opinions
meta_reasoning_queries.reasoning_succeeds_because: Tracks expectation reversal: 'wasn't expecting much', 'wow, was I wrong'
